response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT total_spent, 1.0 * total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), shares_with_average AS (SELECT total_spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_difference FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
